items.assumption: FRANK replay/provenance needs deterministic text identity.
items.independent_discriminator: Unicode standards plus hosted exact/NFC/NFKC counterexample corpus
items.result: Deterministic identity does not imply global normalization; generic String should remain exact unless a type/operator explicitly requests normalization.

adversarial_check.counterhypothesis: Global NFC on all generic Strings is simpler and sufficient.
adversarial_check.detail: Canonically equivalent strings can have different scalar-sequence observables; global NFC changes generic String behavior unless semantics are explicitly redefined.

note: The primary finding is compiler/Unicode-specific and does not rely on FRANK-ClayCode agreement as independent evidence.
